settings.heading: You've got Qs, we've got As

settings.text: We answer all your burning questions about our popular Root Shake. Don't see your question below? Contact us here.

settings.heading: Is Root gluten free, lactose free, and nut free?
settings.row_content: Yep, it sure is. Root is top-9 allergen free, which means you won’t find any milk, eggs, nuts, fish, crustaceans, shellfish, wheat, soy or sesame in our product.

settings.heading: Is Root vegan?
settings.row_content: Yes, it is vegan. We were very intentional about what we put into our product, and created Root so that as many women as possible would be able to consume it, no matter their dietary needs. All of our ingredients, including our protein, are plant-based, and our vitamins are from vegan sources like lichen.

settings.heading: Are Root products tested for harmful contaminants?
settings.row_content:
Absolutely. Julia, our founder, was a big stickler on this one. 

Our products are third-party tested for: TESTS TKTKTK. 

We are also compliant with California Prop 65, meaning our products meet or exceed strict regulatory requirements for levels of harmful contaminants. 

When we say we’re a clean product, we mean it. 

You can find our latest test results on this page. [HYPERLINK]

settings.heading: How quickly should I expect to see results?
settings.row_content:
Every body reacts differently to various galactagogues and ingredients, so results vary from person to person. 

But what we can tell you is that, in our consumer study of INCLUDE CONSUMER STUDY RESULTS. 

Again, everyone responds differently to lactation boosters, so your results may vary. If you don’t experience an increase in milk supply within a few days, stick with it. 

Also keep in mind many factors affect breast milk levels, such as hydration, proper nutrition, and stress. 

Root is designed to boost your existing hydration and nutrition, so make sure you are getting enough water and are feeding your body the healthy nourishment it needs. Remember, most women need an extra 200-500 calories a day to breastfeed! 

As for the stress thing… Well, raising a baby is stressful, what can we say?! Seek support where you can, take time for yourself (no seriously, step away from the baby), try not to “rage clean”, and do whatever it takes to make your little one smile or giggle—their silly little grin is a guaranteed stress buster.

settings.heading: Should I consult my doctor before trying your product?
settings.row_content: While all of our ingredients are safe for mom and baby and have been medically reviewed by board-certified medical doctors, it is always recommended that you consult with your doctor or licensed healthcare professional before taking any new supplements or making dietary changes.

settings.heading: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.row_content:
We know how important it is to keep your milk supply up, so we get it – you needed your Root, like, yesterday. We offer same-day or next-day shipping to get you your Root ASAP.

All orders placed Monday through Friday before 3pm EST are processed the same day. Any orders placed after 3pm EST, on a national holiday, or over the weekend are processed the next business day. When your order is processed, you will receive an email notification that contains your shipment’s tracking number. Please allow up to 24 hours for your tracking number to be live in the carrier’s system.

Please allow 5-7 business days for ground transportation deliveries and 2-3 business days for expedited shipping.

settings.heading: I think my package got lost. What should I do?
settings.row_content: If the tracking number says the package has not left our Atlanta, GA, shipping facility, please reach out to support@roothelps.com for assistance. If it looks like your package was delivered or is stuck in transit, please contact the carrier at NUMBER and they will help you resolve the issue.

settings.heading: Can I cancel or change my order?
settings.row_content:
We start getting your shipment ready immediately, and unfortunately, we can’t cancel or make any changes to orders that have already been processed. Reach out to support@roothelps.com ASAP to check on the status of your order and whether there’s still time to cancel or make changes.

If you need to reschedule an upcoming subscription shipment, you can login to your account to make changes to your next shipment date. You may cancel your subscription at any time by logging into your account [HYPERLINK?] or by contacting support@roothelps.com.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content:
If for any reason you are not satisfied with your purchase, you may request a refund within 15 days of delivery of your first order. We’ll refund you for the full cost of the product less shipping. Refunds apply to your first order only, not any subsequent shipments. 

While our products contain a specific blend of galactagogues (i.e., lactation support ingredients) that are considered effective for most individuals, every body responds differently to certain lactation support ingredients. 

So if you are new to lactation support supplements, or just want to see how Root works for you, we strongly recommend trying our Starter Pack [HYPERLINK]. 

And as always, please consult with your healthcare professional before starting any supplements, making changes to your diet or nutrition, and regarding any interactions between our products and any medications you are taking.

settings.heading: How can I make changes to my subscription?
settings.row_content: You purchased a subscription to make your life easier, good for you! If you need to make changes to your subscription, such as shipment frequency or your next shipment date, you may do so at any time by logging in to your account [HYPERLINK TO ACCOUNT LOGIN]. You can also make changes to your account information, such as billing, shipping address and contact information, by logging into your account.

settings.heading: How can I cancel my subscription?
settings.row_content: If your breastfeeding journey has come to an end—*sniff, sniff* (or, maybe, YAHOO!)—and you wish to cancel your subscription, or if you wish to cancel your subscription for any reason, you may do so at any time by logging into your account [HYPERLINK] or emailing support@roothelps.com.
